rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Nandi bear, ferocious East African cryptid.
ANATOMY: One very powerfully built reddish-haired carnivore, HIGH FRONT SHOULDERS, long feet; quadruped anatomy with one head, two eyes, four legs and one tail. Bearlike head without added horns. [c05,c06]
MOMENT: Rear aggressively on hind legs and drive long forefeet down toward the viewer, jaws open mid-charge. [c12]
POWER: No supernatural power or gore: physical attack threat and kicked-up savanna dirt from motion [c12]
SCALE & CAMERA: Extreme low angle close confrontation, high shoulder profile clearly readable; fairly large animal scale c12
LIGHT & WEATHER: Single low amber moonlight edge, black walnut shadows
SURFACE: Rough shaggy reddish fur, worn teeth, soil on long feet
SETTING: Savannas of Kenya and Tanzania at night, dry grass close behind [c18,c12]
MOOD: Very fierce nocturnal man-killing carnivore c12, no victim shown
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-inscription, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; fully opaque covering where human skin would be nude; no explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. One square image, native resolution at least 1024x1024.

aura: Ferocious build c05/c06; documented hind-leg stance and aggression c12.
artistic_choices: Bearlike facial interpretation editorial from creature name; excludes speculative hyena and extinct-herbivore identities. No scalp/brain imagery. Dirt only contact motion.

visual_review.notes: Native dan 200px dilihat. Uji Sangar 7/7 ya: reddish shaggy fur, massive raised shoulders, elongated forefeet c05/c06, four-limbed carnivore rearing c12, active confronting charge; soil is physical contact only, no gore/text/magic.

root_visual_review.notes: Reads as an ordinary grizzly bear charging in the savanna — the 'ordinary animal' failure. The bear face is an editorial guess from the name only (artistic_choices); the documented traits that would set it apart, the high front shoulders and long feet [nandi-bear-c05, c06], are hidden by the rearing pose. Redraw with a clearly sloping back and markedly high front shoulders, long feet and shaggy reddish hair, a fierce head that copies neither a bear nor a hyena, standing on its hind legs at night [c12]; the hut-doorway ambush of c14 would make a strong setting. Keep no scalping or brain imagery.
